```{r}
# =========================================================================
# 1. Calculate Raw Summary Statistics (Mean, SE, SD, Median)
# =========================================================================
raw_stats <- df_modeling %>%
  group_by(Site, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    raw_mean   = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    raw_median = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd         = sd(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    se         = sd / sqrt(n),
    # Error bars for SE
    lower_se   = raw_mean - se,
    upper_se   = raw_mean + se,
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

# Make sure site is a factor matching your layout
raw_stats$Site   <- factor(raw_stats$Site)
df_modeling$Site <- factor(df_modeling$Site)

# =========================================================================
# 2. Plot Raw Means + SE + Raw Points
# =========================================================================
p_raw_summary <- ggplot() +
  # --- Background Raw Individual Data Points ---
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_modeling,
    aes(x = Site, y = slope, color = Species, shape=K_3),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.55),
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 2.0
  ) +
  
  # --- Raw Means (Large Solid Points) ---
  geom_point(
    data = raw_stats,
    aes(x = Site, y = raw_mean, color = Species),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.55),
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  
  # --- Raw Standard Error Bars ---
  geom_errorbar(
    data = raw_stats,
    aes(x = Site, ymin = lower_se, ymax = upper_se, color = Species),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.55),
    width = 0.20,
    linewidth = 0.85
  ) +
  
  # --- Aesthetics & Formatting ---
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors, name = "species") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Raw Data Summaries: Mean ± SE",
    subtitle = "Summary statistics calculated directly from observed ED50 values",
    x        = "Site",
    y        = "ED50"
  )

print(p_raw_summary)

library(visreg)
```

```{r}
#models
spp_m <- lmer(slope ~ Species + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k3_model <-lmer(slope ~ K_3 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k4_model <-lmer(slope ~ K_4 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k3ms <- lmer(slope ~ Species + K_3 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k4ms <- lmer(slope ~ Species + K_4 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k3msi <- lmer(slope ~ Species * K_3 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k4msi <- lmer(slope ~ Species * K_4 + (1 | Site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k3_spp_random <- lmer(slope ~ K_3 + (1 | Site) + (1 | Species), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k4_spp_random <- lmer(slope ~ K_4 + (1 | Site) + (1 | Species), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)


all_models <- list(
  spp_m    = spp_m,
  k3_model = k3_model,
  k4_model = k4_model,
  k3ms     = k3ms,
  k4ms     = k4ms,
  k3msi    = k3msi,
  k4msi    = k4msi,
  k3_spp_random = k3_spp_random,
  k4_spp_random = k4_spp_random
)

# 2. Extract AIC, BIC, and both R2 values together
master_model_table <- imap_dfr(all_models, function(model_obj, model_name) {
  
  # Grab information criteria
 perf <- model_performance(model_obj, estimator = "ML")
  
  # Grab variance partition metrics
  r2_vals <- r2(model_obj)
  
  data.frame(
    Model_Name      = model_name,
    AIC             = round(perf$AIC, 1),
    BIC             = round(perf$BIC, 1),
    Marginal_R2     = round(r2_vals$R2_marginal, 3),
    Conditional_R2  = round(r2_vals$R2_conditional, 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

# 3. View the table sorted by AIC to look at the trade-offs cleanly
print(master_model_table %>% arrange(AIC))
#k3ms is best

k3_emmeans_obj <- emmeans(all_models$k3ms, pairwise ~ K_3, adjust = "tukey")
k3_emm_df <- as.data.frame(k3_emmeans_obj$emmeans)
k3_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(k3_emmeans_obj$contrasts)

cat("--- Estimated Marginal Means (ED50) for K_3 Clusters ---\n")
print(k3_emm_df %>% dplyr::select(K_3, emmean, SE, df, lower.CL, upper.CL))

cat("\n--- Pairwise Tukey Contrasts Between K_3 Clusters ---\n")
print(k3_contrasts_df %>% dplyr::select(contrast, estimate, SE, p.value))

#BEST MODEL k3ms 
# --- 1. Model Checks & ANOVA ---
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(resid(k3ms) ~ fitted(k3ms), main = "Residuals vs Fitted (k3ms)", xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Residuals")
qqnorm(resid(k3ms), main = "Normal Q-Q Plot (k3ms)")
qqline(resid(k3ms), col = "red")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1)) 

#Test overall significance of single model
anova(k3ms)  #both are sig, p < 0.001

# --- 2. Extract EMMs &  Letter Display ---
k3ms_cluster_emm <- emmeans(k3ms, specs = ~ K_3) 

# Convert EMM to dataframe and compute CLD letters
cld_clusters <- cld(k3ms_cluster_emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    K_3 = as.factor(K_3),
    .group = trimws(.group)
  )

#factor level

cluster_levels <- c("ICRA", "Acropora_1", "Acropora_2")
df_modeling <- df_modeling %>%
  mutate(
    K_3_str = as.character(K_3),
    K_3_labeled = case_match(
      K_3_str,
      "2" ~ "ICRA",
      "1" ~ "Acropora_1",
      "3" ~ "Acropora_2",
      .default = K_3_str
    ),
    K_3_labeled = factor(K_3_labeled, levels = cluster_levels)
  )

#align cld_clusters identically
cld_clusters <- cld_clusters %>%
  mutate(
    K_3_str = as.character(K_3),
    K_3_labeled = case_match(
      K_3_str,
      "2" ~ "ICRA",
      "1" ~ "Acropora_1",
      "3" ~ "Acropora_2",
      .default = K_3_str
    ),
    K_3_labeled = factor(K_3_labeled, levels = cluster_levels)
  )

# 4. Generate Plot (both layers now use identical K_3_labeled factors)
plot_k3ms <- ggplot() +
  # Layer A: Raw jittered points
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_modeling, 
    aes(x = K_3_labeled, y = slope, color = Species, fill = Species, shape = Site),
    width = 0.18, 
    alpha = 0.55, 
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  # Layer B: Model Estimated Marginal Means (Black points + Error bars)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = cld_clusters,
    aes(x = K_3_labeled, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    width = 0.12, 
    linewidth = 0.9, 
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cld_clusters,
    aes(x = K_3_labeled, y = emmean),
    size = 4, 
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Layer C: Statistical significance letters (CLD)
  geom_text(
    data = cld_clusters,
    aes(x = K_3_labeled, y = upper.CL + 0.15, label = .group),
    fontface = "bold", 
    size = 5.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Styling & Labels
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
   axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Photophysiological Cluster",
    y = slope,
    color = "Species",
    fill  = "Species",
    shape = "Site"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors, limits = species_order) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors, limits = species_order) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = custom_shapes)

print(plot_k3ms)
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(patchwork)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Setup Data for the Winning k3ms Model
# ==============================================================================
Ychoice <- "ED50" # Set to "ED50" or your color slope variable name

cb_clean <- cb %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[Ychoice]]), !is.na(Species), !is.na(Site), !is.na(K_3)) %>%
  mutate(
    YY      = .data[[Ychoice]],
    Species = droplevels(as.factor(Species)),
    Site    = droplevels(as.factor(Site)),
    K_3     = droplevels(as.factor(K_3)),
    # Create the Species x Cluster identifier for plotting
    HH      = droplevels(as.factor(paste0(Species, "_", K_3)))
  )

# Filter low-sample HH groups if necessary (purgelimit = 6)
purgelimit <- 5
hh_counts  <- table(cb_clean$HH)
valid_hh   <- names(hh_counts[hh_counts >= purgelimit])

cb_plot <- cb_clean %>% 
  filter(HH %in% valid_hh) %>% 
  mutate(
    Species = droplevels(Species),
    K_3     = droplevels(K_3),
    HH      = droplevels(HH)
  )

# Calculate sample sizes and median outcome per HH combination for ordering
hh_summary <- cb_plot %>% 
  group_by(HH) %>% 
  summarize(N = n(), mnYY = median(YY, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(mnYY))

cb_plot$HH    <- factor(cb_plot$HH, levels = hh_summary$HH)
hh_summary$HH <- factor(hh_summary$HH, levels = hh_summary$HH)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Fit Winning Model (k3ms) & Extract EMMs for Species x K_3 Combinations
# ==============================================================================
# Fit your exact winning model: YY ~ Species + K_3 + (1|Site)
k3ms_plot_model <- lmer(YY ~ Species + K_3 + (1|Site), data = cb_plot, REML = FALSE)

# Extract Estimated Marginal Means for the combined Species x K_3 grid
emm_hh <- emmeans(k3ms_plot_model, ~ Species : K_3)

# Filter out non-existent/empty species-cluster grid cells
emm_hh_df <- as.data.frame(emm_hh) %>%
  mutate(HH = paste0(Species, "_", K_3)) %>%
  filter(HH %in% levels(cb_plot$HH)) %>%
  mutate(HH = factor(HH, levels = hh_summary$HH))

# Pairwise Tukey contrasts across combinations
pairs_hh  <- pairs(emm_hh, adjust = "tukey")
pairs_sum <- summary(pairs_hh)

# Generate Compact Letter Display (CLD) safely
pvals <- pairs_sum$p.value
pvals[is.na(pvals)] <- 1 # Safeguard against missing contrast cells
names(pvals) <- gsub(" - ", "-", pairs_sum$contrast)

# Clean string names to match factor levels
names(pvals) <- gsub("Species|K_3| ", "", names(pvals))

letters_out <- multcompLetters(pvals)$Letters
emm_hh_df$group <- letters_out[match(as.character(emm_hh_df$HH), names(letters_out))]

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Plot 1: ED50 across Species x K3 Cluster (HH)
# ==============================================================================
y_min <- min(cb_plot$YY, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.5
y_max <- max(cb_plot$YY, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5

Hplot <- ggplot(cb_plot, aes(x = HH, y = YY)) +
  # Raw data points colored by Species and shaped by Site
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Species, shape = factor(Site)), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  # Model EMMs & SE error bars from k3ms
  geom_point(aes(x = HH, y = emmean), data = emm_hh_df, size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = HH, y = emmean, ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), 
                data = emm_hh_df, width = 0.2, color = "black") +
  # Sample sizes at bottom
  geom_text(aes(x = HH, y = y_min, label = paste0("n=", N)), data = hh_summary, size = 3) +
  # Significance letters at top
  geom_text(aes(x = HH, y = y_max, label = group), data = emm_hh_df, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = 1:8) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(Ychoice, " across Species x K3 Clusters (Model: k3ms)"),
    x = "Species_Cluster (HH)",
    y = expression(ED[50] ~ " (" * degree * C * ")"),
    shape = "Site",
    color = "Species"
  )

print(Hplot)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Plot 2: Species Turnover Across ED50 Quantile Bins
# ==============================================================================
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Define Explicit Ordering Vector & Data Prep
# ==============================================================================
KK_order <- c("ICRA_2", "AGLO_1", "AGLO_3", "AABR_1", "AABR_3", "AHYA_1")
KK_names <- c(
  "ICRA_2" = "ICRA", 
  "AGLO_1" = "AGLO_1", 
  "AGLO_3" = "AGLO_2", 
  "AABR_1" = "AABR_1", 
  "AABR_3" = "AABR_2", 
  "AHYA_1" = "AHYA_1")

species_labels <- c(
  "AGLO" = "A. globiceps",
  "AABR" = "A. abrotanoides",
  "AHYA" = "A. hyacinthus",
  "ICRA" = "I. crateriformis"
)

df_hh <- df_modeling %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED50), !is.na(Species), !is.na(Site), !is.na(K_3)) %>%
  mutate(
    HH = paste0(Species, "_", K_3),
    HH = factor(HH, levels = KK_order),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HH)) # Keep only the 6 target combinations

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Fit Model & Robustly Extract EMMs with Compact Letters
# ==============================================================================
# Fit model with HH as fixed factor
m_hh <- lmer(ED50 ~ HH + (1|Site), data = df_hh, REML = FALSE)

# Compute EMMs directly for HH
emm_hh_obj <- emmeans(m_hh, ~ HH)

# Generate Compact Letter Display
cld_raw <- as.data.frame(multcomp::cld(emm_hh_obj, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters))

# Dynamically find the lower and upper confidence limit columns
lcl_col <- names(cld_raw)[grep("LCL|lower.CL", names(cld_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
ucl_col <- names(cld_raw)[grep("UCL|upper.CL", names(cld_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]

cld_hh <- cld_raw %>%
  mutate(
    HH      = factor(HH, levels = KK_order),
    ymin    = .data[[lcl_col]],
    ymax    = .data[[ucl_col]],
    .group  = trimws(.group),
    Species = factor(sub("_.*", "", HH), levels = species_order)
  )

# Sample size summary
hh_summary <- df_hh %>%
  group_by(HH) %>%
  summarize(N = n(), .groups = "drop")

KK_raw_order <- c("ICRA_2", "AGLO_1", "AGLO_3", "AABR_1", "AABR_3", "AHYA_1")

# Lookup vector for plot labels
KK_names <- c(
  "ICRA_2" = "ICRA", 
  "AGLO_1" = "AGLO_1", 
  "AGLO_3" = "AGLO_2", 
  "AABR_1" = "AABR_1", 
  "AABR_3" = "AABR_2", 
  "AHYA_1" = "AHYA_1"
)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Plot 1: Raw Data + EMMs + Significance Letters
# ==============================================================================
y_min <- min(df_hh$ED50, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.4
y_max <- max(cld_hh$ymax, max(df_hh$ED50, na.rm = TRUE)) + 0.4

plot_hh_raw <- ggplot() +
  # Raw jittered points
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_hh,
    aes(x = HH, y = ED50, color = Species, fill = Species, shape = Site),
    width = 0.18,
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 2.8
  ) +
  # EMM points + Error bars (using standardized ymin and ymax)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = cld_hh,
    aes(x = HH, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    width = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cld_hh,
    aes(x = HH, y = emmean),
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Sample sizes
  geom_text(
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Define explicit display order
KK_order <- c("ICRA", "AGLO_1", "AGLO_2", "AABR_1", "AABR_2", "AHYA_1")

# 2. Recode HH and calculate summary stats (Raw Mean and SE)
df_hh_plot <- df_modeling %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED50), !is.na(Species), !is.na(Site), !is.na(K_3)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Recode raw HH levels to clean display labels
    HH_raw = paste0(Species, "_", K_3),
    HH = case_match(
      HH_raw,
      "ICRA_2" ~ "ICRA",
      "AGLO_1" ~ "AGLO_1",
      "AGLO_3" ~ "AGLO_2",
      "AABR_1" ~ "AABR_1",
      "AABR_3" ~ "AABR_2",
      "AHYA_1" ~ "AHYA_1",
      .default = HH_raw
    ),
    HH = factor(HH, levels = KK_order),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HH))

# Descriptive summary table (Observed Mean & SE per HH group)
hh_summary <- df_hh_plot %>%
  group_by(HH, Species) %>%
  summarize(
    N      = n(),
    mean_Y = mean(ED50, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_Y   = sd(ED50, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Plot Raw Data + Observed Group Means
y_min <- min(df_hh_plot$ED50, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.4

plot_hh_raw_only <- ggplot() +
  # Layer 1: Raw individual data points (color + fill mapped to Species)
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_hh_plot,
    aes(x = HH, y = ED50, color = Species, fill = Species, shape = Site),
    width = 0.18,
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 2.8
  ) +
  # Layer 2: Observed Group Mean + SE (Black crossbars)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = hh_summary,
    aes(x = HH, ymin = mean_Y - se_Y, ymax = mean_Y + se_Y),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = hh_summary,
    aes(x = HH, y = mean_Y),
    size = 3.8,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "black",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Layer 3: Sample size annotations (n = ...)
  geom_text(
    data = hh_summary,
    aes(x = HH, y = y_min, label = paste0("n=", N)),
    size = 3.5,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  # Formatting & Scales
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression(Raw ~"("*ED[50]*")"~across~Species-Cluster~Combinations),
    x = "Species_Cluster",
    y = expression(ED[50] ~ " (" * degree * C * ")"),
    color = "Species",
    fill  = "Species",
    shape = "Site"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors, limits = species_order) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors, limits = species_order) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = custom_shapes) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = KK_order)

print(plot_hh_raw_only)
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(patchwork)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Setup & Clean Dataset
# ==============================================================================
Ychoice <- "ED50" # Change to "slope" or "Paling" for color slope
cb_clean <- cb %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[Ychoice]]), !is.na(Species), !is.na(Site), !is.na(K_3)) %>%
  mutate(
    YY      = .data[[Ychoice]],
    Species = droplevels(as.factor(Species)),
    Site    = droplevels(as.factor(Site)),
    KK      = droplevels(as.factor(K_3)),
    # Create Species x Cluster factor
    HH      = droplevels(as.factor(paste0(Species, "_", KK)))
  )

# Filter out low-sample HH groups if needed (purgelimit = 6)
purgelimit <- 6
hh_counts <- table(cb_clean$HH)
valid_hh  <- names(hh_counts[hh_counts >= purgelimit])

cb_plot <- cb_clean %>% filter(HH %in% valid_hh) %>% mutate(HH = droplevels(HH))

# Order HH levels by descending median YY
hh_order <- cb_plot %>% 
  group_by(HH) %>% 
  summarize(N = n(), mnYY = median(YY, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(mnYY))

cb_plot$HH <- factor(cb_plot$HH, levels = hh_order$HH)
hh_order$HH <- factor(hh_order$HH, levels = hh_order$HH)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Fit Model & Calculate Post-Hoc Compact Letters for HH
# ==============================================================================
# Fit LMM with HH as fixed effect and Site as random effect (omitting (1|Species) to avoid aliasing)
m_hh <- lmer(YY ~ HH + (1|Site), data = cb_plot, REML = FALSE)

# Compute EMMs for HH
emm_hh <- emmeans(m_hh, ~ HH)
pairs_hh <- pairs(emm_hh, adjust = "tukey")

# Generate compact letter display (CLD)
pvals <- summary(pairs_hh)$p.value
names(pvals) <- gsub(" - ", "-", summary(pairs_hh)$contrast)

letters_out <- multcompLetters(pvals)$Letters
names(letters_out) <- gsub("HH", "", names(letters_out))

# Combine EMMs and letter groups into a plot dataframe
emdf_hh <- as.data.frame(emm_hh) %>%
  mutate(
    group = letters_out[match(HH, names(letters_out))],
    HH    = factor(HH, levels = hh_order$HH)
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Plot Species x Cluster (HH) with Points, EMMs, and Significance Letters
# ==============================================================================
Hplot <- ggplot(cb_plot, aes(x = HH, y = YY)) +
  # Individual raw data points jittered by Site and colored by Species
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Species, shape = factor(Site)), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  # Estimated Marginal Means and Error Bars
  geom_point(aes(x = HH, y = emmean), data = emdf_hh, size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = HH, y = emmean, ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), data = emdf_hh, width = 0.2, color = "black") +
  # Sample size N at bottom
  geom_text(aes(x = HH, y = min(cb_plot$YY, na.rm=TRUE) - 0.5, label = paste0("n=", N)), data = hh_order, size = 3) +
  # Compact letter display at top
  geom_text(aes(x = HH, y = max(cb_plot$YY, na.rm=TRUE) + 0.5, label = group), data = emdf_hh, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = 1:8) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(Ychoice, " across Species x K3 Cluster Combinations"),
    x = "Species_Cluster (HH)",
    y = Ychoice,
    shape = "Site",
    color = "Species"
  )

print(Hplot)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Species Turnover Across Quantile Bins Plot
# ==============================================================================
cb_clean$YY_CUT <- cut(cb_clean$YY, breaks = 5)

Species_Turnover <- cb_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(YY_CUT)) %>%
  group_by(Species, YY_CUT) %>%
  summarize(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = YY_CUT, y = N, fill = Species)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Species Proportions across", Ychoice, "Quantiles"),
    x = paste(Ychoice, "Bins"),
    y = "Proportion of Samples"
  )

print(Species_Turnover)
```

```{r}
anova_table <- lapply(names(top_models), function(model_name) {
  m <- top_models[[model_name]]
  an <- anova(m)
  
  as.data.frame(an) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name)
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, term, everything()) # Keeps it scannable

print(anova_table)

var_table <- imap_dfr(top_models, function(m, model_name) {
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(m))
  
  # Extract site variance safely
  site_var <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "site"] 
  if(length(site_var) == 0) site_var <- 0 # Fallback safety if variance is exactly 0
  
  # Extract residual variance
  resid_var <- attr(VarCorr(m), "sc")^2
  total <- site_var + resid_var
  
  tibble(
    Model             = model_name,
    Site_variance     = site_var,
    Residual_variance = resid_var,
    Site_prop         = site_var / total,
    Residual_prop     = resid_var / total
  )
})

print(var_table)

emmeans_table <- imap_dfr(top_models, function(m, model_name) {
  # Calculate post-hoc differences between your species lines
  em <- emmeans(m, ~ species)
  
  tidy(pairs(em)) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name)
})
```

```{r}
#plot tom's "efficiency frontier"
library(ggrepel) # For non-overlapping labels

# 1. Prepare data (using Conditional_R2 as the primary metric)
# Change 'Conditional_R2' to 'Marginal_R2' if preferred
plot_data <- master_model_table %>%
  rename(R2_target = Conditional_R2)

# 2. Compute the Efficiency (Pareto) Frontier
# Sort by BIC ascending, then calculate cumulative max R2
frontier_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(BIC, desc(R2_target)) %>%
  mutate(cum_max_R2 = cummax(R2_target)) %>%
  filter(R2_target == cum_max_R2) %>%
  distinct(R2_target, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 3. Tag models in main table as Efficient vs. Suboptimal
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(is_frontier = Model_Name %in% frontier_data$Model_Name)

# 4. Generate Efficiency Frontier Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = BIC, y = R2_target)) +
  # Draw step line for efficiency frontier
  # geom_step(
  #   data = frontier_data,
  #   aes(x = BIC, y = R2_target),
  #   direction = "hv",
  #   color = "#1f77b4",
  #   linewidth = 1,
  #   linetype = "dashed"
  # ) +
  # Points for suboptimal models
  geom_point(
    data = filter(plot_data, !is_frontier),
    color = "gray60",
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  # Highlight points on the efficiency frontier
  geom_point(
    data = filter(plot_data, is_frontier),
    color = "#1f77b4",
    size = 4
  ) +
  # Model Labels (non-overlapping)
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Model_Name, color = is_frontier),
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = ifelse(plot_data$is_frontier, "bold", "plain"),
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#1f77b4", "FALSE" = "gray30")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Efficiency Frontier (BIC vs. Conditional R²)",
    #subtitle = "Dashed line marks Pareto-optimal models (higher R² for a given BIC penalty)",
    x = "BIC ",
    y = expression("Conditional " * R^2 * "")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
#plot by species 
# 2. Convert to a clean dataframe, dropping rows that have no data (the NAs)
cld_spp <- cld(k3ms_raw_emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  filter(!is.na(emmean)) %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(as.character(.group)))

# Print this out to verify the column names before plotting!
print(cld_spp) 

cld_spp_plot <- cld_spp %>%
  mutate(
    K_3 = factor(paste("Cluster", K_3)),
    species = toupper(species) # Standardize naming case if needed
  )

df_raw_clean <- df_modeling %>%
  mutate(
    species = toupper(species),
    K_3 = factor(paste("Cluster", K_3))
  )

# 2. Clean the EMMeans CLD data frame identically
cld_spp_plot <- cld_spp %>%
  mutate(
    species = toupper(species),
    K_3 = factor(paste("Cluster", K_3)),
    .group = trimws(as.character(.group))
  )

# 3. Dynamic layout math for text placement
y_range <- max(cld_spp_plot$upper.CL, na.rm = TRUE) - min(cld_spp_plot$lower.CL, na.rm = TRUE)
text_offset <- y_range * 0.06

# 4. Generate the combined plot
plot_jittered <- ggplot() +
  # STEP A: Plot the raw data points in the background (jittered horizontally)
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_raw_clean, 
    aes(x = species, y = ED50, color = species),
    alpha = 0.35,       # Makes raw data slightly transparent
    width = 0.2,        # Spread of the jittering
    height = 0          # Do not jitter vertically (keeps true ED50 values)
  ) +
  # STEP B: Layer the EMMeans model results explicitly on top using a separate dataset
  geom_errorbar(
    data = cld_spp_plot,
    aes(x = species, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    color = "black", width = 0.15, linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cld_spp_plot,
    aes(x = species, y = emmean, fill = species),
    color = "black", shape = 21, size = 4.5, stroke = 1.5
  ) +
  # STEP C: Add the post-hoc significance letter labels
  geom_text(
    data = cld_spp_plot,
    aes(x = species, y = upper.CL + text_offset, label = .group), 
    color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 5
  ) +
  # Split into identical grid panels by cluster
  facet_wrap(~ K_3) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank() # Cleans up vertical grid lines
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Species Identity",
    y = expression(ED[50]~"("*degree*C*")")
  )
```

```{r}
#Plot: Facet by species, look at clusters in groups.

# --- 1. Filter out missing values and clean up factor levels for K=3 ---
df_plot_k3 <- df_modeling %>%
  filter(!is.na(K_3), !is.na(site), !is.na(ED50)) %>%
  mutate(
    species_label = toupper(trimws(species)),
    site_factor   = as.factor(site)
  )

# --- 2. Define 8 explicit, high-contrast shapes to prevent the 6-shape cutoff ---
# 15=Square, 16=Circle, 17=Triangle, 18=Diamond, 
# 21=Bordered Circle, 22=Bordered Square, 23=Bordered Diamond, 24=Bordered Triangle
custom_shapes <- c(15, 16, 17, 18, 21, 22, 23, 24)

# --- 3. Build the Faceted Plot ---
plot_k3_shifts <- ggplot(df_plot_k3, aes(x = as.factor(K_3), y = ED50, fill = site_factor)) +
  
  # Clean, minimalist boxplots showing the median and IQR distributions
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA, color = "grey30", fill = "grey98") +
  
  # Overlay individual data points, manually assigning our 8 shape codes
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = site_factor, color = site_factor), 
              width = 0.15, alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5) +
  
  # Separate panels for each species with their own x-axes to match who actually lived where
  facet_wrap(~ species_label, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  
  # Color and Shape overrides
 # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = custom_shapes) +
  
  # Aesthetic cleanups
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",              # Stacks Species and Site legends beautifully
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(
    #title = "Heat Tolerance Shifts Across K=3 Physiological Clusters",
   # subtitle = "Showing significant thermal threshold expansion in AABR and AGLO",
    x = "Photophysiological Cluster Assignment (K=3)",
    y = expression(ED[50]~"("*degree*C*")"),
   # color = "Species Identity",
    shape = "Collection Site"
  )

# Display the plot
print(plot_k3_shifts)

# Save the plot with a broad layout to accommodate the side-by-side species view
#ggsave(here("Plots", "ED50_Shifts_K3_Faceted.png"),  plot = plot_k3_shifts, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(emmeans)

# --- 1. Create the new fused factor for K = 4 ---
df_modeling <- df_modeling %>%
  mutate(Spp_Cluster_4 = factor(paste(species, K_4, sep = "_")))

# Print this so you can see exactly which clusters aabr and aglo landed in!
cat("Sample counts per Species-Cluster combo (K=4):\n")
print(table(df_modeling$Spp_Cluster_4))

# --- 2. Fit the model ---
k4ms_joint <- lmer(ED50 ~ Spp_Cluster_4 + (1 | site), 
                   data = df_modeling, 
                   REML = TRUE)

# --- 3. Extract the pairwise comparisons ---
joint_emm_4 <- emmeans(k4ms_joint, specs = ~ Spp_Cluster_4)
all_pairs_4 <- as.data.frame(pairs(joint_emm_4, adjust = "tukey"))

# --- 4. Look at shifts within species ---
# This filters the giant list to ONLY show comparisons within the same species
within_species_shifts_4 <- all_pairs_4 %>%
  filter(
    (str_detect(contrast, "aabr") & !str_detect(contrast, "aglo|ahya|icra")) |
    (str_detect(contrast, "aglo") & !str_detect(contrast, "aabr|ahya|icra")) |
    (str_detect(contrast, "icra") & !str_detect(contrast, "aabr|ahya|aglo"))
  )
```

```{r}
# 2. Convert to a clean dataframe, dropping rows that have no data (the NAs)
cld_spp <- cld(k4ms_raw_emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  filter(!is.na(emmean)) %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(as.character(.group)))

# Print this out to verify the column names before plotting!
print(cld_spp) 

cld_spp_plot <- cld_spp %>%
  mutate(
    K_4 = factor(paste("Cluster", K_4)),
    species = toupper(species) # Standardize naming case if needed
  )

df_raw_clean <- df_modeling %>%
  mutate(
    species = toupper(species),
    K_4 = factor(paste("Cluster", K_4))
  )

# 2. Clean the EMMeans CLD data frame identically
cld_spp_plot <- cld_spp %>%
  mutate(
    species = toupper(species),
    K_4 = factor(paste("Cluster", K_4)),
    .group = trimws(as.character(.group))
  )

# 3. Dynamic layout math for text placement
y_range <- max(cld_spp_plot$upper.CL, na.rm = TRUE) - min(cld_spp_plot$lower.CL, na.rm = TRUE)
text_offset <- y_range * 0.06

# 4. Generate the combined plot
plot_jittered <- ggplot() +
  # STEP A: Plot the raw data points in the background (jittered horizontally)
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_raw_clean, 
    aes(x = species, y = ED50, color = species),
    alpha = 0.35,       # Makes raw data slightly transparent
    width = 0.2,        # Spread of the jittering
    height = 0          # Do not jitter vertically (keeps true ED50 values)
  ) +
  # STEP B: Layer the EMMeans model results explicitly on top using a separate dataset
  geom_errorbar(
    data = cld_spp_plot,
    aes(x = species, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    color = "black", width = 0.15, linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cld_spp_plot,
    aes(x = species, y = emmean, fill = species),
    color = "black", shape = 21, size = 4.5, stroke = 1.5
  ) +
  # STEP C: Add the post-hoc significance letter labels
  geom_text(
    data = cld_spp_plot,
    aes(x = species, y = upper.CL + text_offset, label = .group), 
    color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 5
  ) +
  # Split into identical grid panels by cluster
  facet_wrap(~ K_4) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank() # Cleans up vertical grid lines
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Species Identity",
    y = expression(ED[50]~"("*degree*C*")")
  )

print(plot_jittered)
```

```{r}
# Loop through and compute AIC using lmer()
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
library(performance)

model_comp <- map_df(k_cols, function(k_name) {
  
  # Fit the model (REML = FALSE is mandatory for comparing fixed structures via AIC)
  form <- as.formula(paste("ED50 ~ species +", k_name, "+ (1 | site)"))
  model <- lmer(form, data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
  
  # Grab AIC and BIC
  perf <- model_performance(model)
  
  data.frame(
    Model          = k_name,
    AIC            = perf$AIC,
    BIC            = perf$BIC,           # Punishes overfitting harder than AIC
    R2_Marginal    = perf$R2_marginal,    # Variance explained by Species + K-Cluster
    R2_Conditional = perf$R2_conditional  # Total variance explained including Site
  )
})

# Arrange by best AIC to see the trade-offs
print(model_comp %>% arrange(AIC))

# 1. Fit the final, optimal model structure
final_model <- lmer(ED50 ~ species + K_5 + (1 | site), 
                    data = df_modeling, 
                    REML = TRUE)

# 2. Look at the coefficients to see WHICH clusters are more tolerant
summary(final_model)

# 3. Check exactly how much heat tolerance separates the groups (in degrees C)
tidy(k2ms, effects = "fixed")

table(df_modeling$species, df_modeling$K_5)

emm_K4 <- emmeans(final_model, ~ K_5)
pairs(emm_K4, adjust = "tukey")

emm_spp <- emmeans(final_model, ~ species)
pairs(emm_spp, adjust = "tukey")

# emm_joint <- emmeans(final_model, ~ species | K_3)
# pairs(emm_joint, adjust = "tukey") #cant do interaction. few overlap


#plot

# 1. Convert EMMs to a readable dataframe
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(final_model, ~ K_3))

# 2. Build the plot
ggplot() +
  # Draw the raw data points in the background (jittered to prevent overlapping)
  geom_jitter(data = df_modeling, 
              aes(x = K_3, y = ED50, color = species), 
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0.2, height = 0) +
  
  # Draw the model's EMMs as large point estimates
  geom_point(data = emm_df, 
             aes(x = K_3, y = emmean, group = species), 
             color = "black", size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  
  # Add Confidence Interval error bars from the model
  geom_errorbar(data = emm_df, 
                aes(x = K_3, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, group = species), 
                color = "black", width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  
  # Clean up formatting
  #facet_wrap(~ species) + 
  labs(title = "Model EMMs (with 95% CI) vs. Raw ED50 Data",
       x = "Cluster (K_3)",
       y = "ED50 (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
  # Add a 1:1 line. If predictions were perfect, dots would sit exactly on this line
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Scatter dots colored by Species and shaped by Cluster Group
  geom_point(aes(color = toupper(species), shape = as.factor(K_3)), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # Add a trend line of your actual fit to see deviation from the 1:1 line
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "darkblue", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.7) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Validation: Predicted vs. Observed Heat Tolerance",
    subtitle = "Dashed Line = Perfect 1:1 Prediction | Solid Line = Actual Model Fit",
    x = expression("Predicted " * ED[50] * " (°C)"),
    y = expression("Observed Raw " * ED[50] * " (°C)"),
    color = "Species",
    shape = "K_3 Cluster"
  )

ggsave(here("Plots", "ED50_Predicted_vs_Raw.png"), plot = plot_pred_vs_raw, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
r2_vals <- model_performance(model)

test_residuals <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model)

k3_m <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_3 + species + (1 | site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k10_m <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_10 + species + (1 | site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k8_m  <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_8 + species + (1 | site),  data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)

# 2. Run the comparative ANOVA (Likelihood Ratio Test)
anova(k3_m, k10_m, k8_m)
#10 is lowest aic when 
summary(k11_m)
summary(k12_m)
summary(k4_m)

r2(k11_m) #conditional () = 0.514, marginal (sites) = 0.242. So, fixed effect explains 17% of variance, site explains 22.5% (39.4-16.9)
r2(k12_m) #conditional () = 0.395, marginal () = 0.170
r2(k4_m) #conditional () = 0.379, marginal () = 0.087
# 1. Calculate the estimated marginal means for each cluster group
k11_means <- emmeans(k11_m, specs = ~ K_11)


# 2. Run the pairwise post-hoc comparisons with Tukey adjustment
k11_posthoc <- pairs(k11_means, adjust = "tukey")

# 3. View the results
# (Optional: filter for only statistically significant differences)
k11_posthoc_df <- as.data.frame(k11_posthoc)

significant_differences <- k11_posthoc_df %>% 
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

print(significant_differences)
pairs(emmeans(k11_m, ~ K_11))
plot(k11_means, comparisons = TRUE)

# Plot residuals against fitted values
plot(k11_m, type = c("p", "smooth"), 
     xlab = "Fitted Values (Predicted ED50)", 
     ylab = "Residuals")

res <- residuals(k11_m)

# Create Q-Q plot
qqnorm(res, main = "Normal Q-Q Plot of Residuals")

custom_order <- c("1", "2", "3", "4",  "9", "7","10", "11", "5", "6",  "8") #make plot then change these if needed

#change order
df_modeling$K_11 <- factor(df_modeling$K_11, levels = custom_order)

# 2. Re-run emmeans (it will automatically adopt the new factor order)
k11_predicted <- as.data.frame(emmeans(k11_m, ~ K_11))


# 2. Plot raw data as points, and model predictions as larger points with error bars
ggplot() +
  # Raw data points (colored by site to see the random effect)
  geom_jitter(data = df_modeling, aes(x = K_11, y = ED50, color = species, shape = site), alpha = 0.5, width = 0.2, size = 3) +
  # Model predictions (Emmeans)
  geom_point(data = k11_predicted, aes(x = K_11, y = emmean), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(data = k11_predicted, aes(x = K_11, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), 
                color = "black", width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Model Fit: Raw ED50 Data vs. Model Predictions",
       x = "K_11 Category",
       y = "ED50")
```

```{r}
# 1. Correct the CLD call to use the EMM object
cld_clusters <- cld(k4ms_cluster_emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(.group))

# 2. Generate Plot
library(ggplot2)

# --- 1. Generate the CLD letters for the clusters ---
cld_clusters <- cld(k4ms_cluster_emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(.group))

# --- 2. Build the Layered Plot ---
plot_cluster_with_raw <- ggplot() +
  
  # LAYER 1: Raw data points in the background, jittered and colored by species
  geom_jitter(data = df_modeling %>% filter(!is.na(K_3)), 
              aes(x = as.factor(K_4), y = ED50, color = species),
              width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 2.5) +
  
  # LAYER 2: Model-estimated marginal means (large open diamond)
  geom_point(data = cld_clusters, 
             aes(x = as.factor(K_4), y = emmean), 
             size = 4.5, shape = 18, color = "black") +
  
  # LAYER 3: 95% Confidence Intervals calculated from the model
  geom_errorbar(data = cld_clusters, 
                aes(x = as.factor(K_4), ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), 
                width = 0.12, linewidth = 1.1, color = "black") +
  
  # LAYER 4: Post-hoc significance letters mapped cleanly above the error bars
  geom_text(data = cld_clusters, 
            aes(x = as.factor(K_4), y = upper.CL + 0.15, label = .group), 
            fontface = "bold", size = 5, color = "black") +
  
  # Formatting & Aesthetics
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Physiological Cluster Thermal Performance",
    subtitle = "Diamonds show model means (95% CI) over raw biological points",
    x = "Photophysiological Cluster Assignment (K=3)",
    y = expression(ED[50]~"("*degree*C*")"),
    color = "Coral Species"
  )

# Display the plot
print(plot_cluster_with_raw)

# Save the plot
ggsave(here("Plots", "EMM_Clusters_K3_with_RawData.png"), 
       plot = plot_cluster_with_raw, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

  )
```
